value.description: Neutral grotesque regular, mixed case, dark on white: about 6% of width inside the bar, jumping to about 22% when the bar disappears at F46-F48.
Authentic web faces at page size; a serif headline in the article. All are built or captured to look like real pages.

Grotesque medium, white, one line at about 3.5% cap height: small for a headline. It spans 40-55% of width. New word arrives yellow and cools to white in about 9 frames. The key phrase sits in a yellow pill with black text.
Very small, at the bottom third, about 1.5% cap height, typed left to right with a light cursor. Their job is credibility, not reading.

Geometric or neutral grotesque, mixed case, very large: 'What if' about 64% of width, 'better' 83% shrinking to 72%, 'way?' about 51%. Between them 'there was a' at 20% shrinking to 16%. Inferred from shapes: something like SF Pro or Inter Display.

composition.value: A fixed point at the centre of the frame across the first half: the phrase, then the person, then the stat. The stat line keeps one height and stays centred while it grows; what is behind it changes. Vertical clips are about 18% of frame width in the column, with rounded corners. In the ending, the words are off-centre, travelling through.

materials.value: Screens as flat paper; real phone-shot video as the human texture; dim sports and road footage at about 25% brightness with a soft vignette behind the text. A soft halo surrounds the white tiles as they appear. Blue light in the end looks like a lit liquid or refraction.

lighting.value: In the ending, type looks lit: soft bloom in the same colour, chromatic edge on the way in, and focus falling off towards the frame edges. Blurred words are not simply transparent; they look out of focus.

styleSummary: Starts as a calm web page and ends as a dark, lit title. Between the two, the kit is a yellow highlighter, real phone video, dim footage and small, confident sentences.
